root: ^Hey Ace, I’m back from my vacation!
^Oh great, finally. Can you help me with this bounty then?
^Yeah yeah of course, just run me through it again won’t ya?
^A bit rusty? Ok here we go… Listen up because I’m only gonna remind you once!
^To move left and right, use the A and D keys. To jump, use the W Key.
^On your way you’ll see some coins. Pick them up to earn money, you’ll be able to start using them soon.
^Once you start getting closer to your bounty Huxley, his minions are going to start attacking you.
^To defeat them, use the mouse to aim and click to shoot your gun. Oh! And to reload the gun, use the Spacebar.
^Watch out! If you get hit by an enemy you lose health!
